q: ChatGPT failed the moving-part layers 3 times (Paper Mill wheel/press, Kang raised arm, Xuan base). How should we finish them?
ctx: Batch L1R2 (2026-10-26) was the third round. Passed and kept: the Paper Mill front layer, Xuan ring + front, Kang rest arm. Failed a third time (6 files): the wheel (shape, spokes and hub now exact and it turns cleanly in game, but the 8 paddles are missing), the press block (no outline of its own), the Paper Mill base (checkerboard and hatched fill behind the wheel and press), Kang base (flat slab behind the arm), Kang raised arm (a bare skin arm instead of his sleeved arm bent), Xuan base (loose brown bits beside the sphere when the ring turns). No further ChatGPT round is requested until you answer; the game keeps the stills with the code stand-ins (press bob, Kang nod, Xuan ring glints). The wheel and press are small fixes (8 paddles, an outline); the bases and Kang raised arm are painting work.

o: inhouse_all
We finish all 6 ourselves from the kept parts (add paddles, outline the press, paint the bases, draw the raised arm from the rest arm)
chatgpt_round
One more ChatGPT round (L1R3) for the 6 files
mix
We do the small fixes (wheel paddles, press outline, Xuan base clean-up); ChatGPT redoes the Paper Mill base and Kang base + raised arm
standins
Keep the code stand-ins and drop these layers for now (no turning wheel, brow wipe or turning ring)
inhouse_future
All of the first option, and from now on we make moving-part layers in-house for later batches too (ChatGPT draws stills only)

q: ChatGPT has failed 7 new-island tiles three times. How should we finish them?
ctx: For Lotus Marsh and Thunder Crag (islands not in the game yet, ADR 0007 Phase 6), ChatGPT keeps sending the same recoloured template: ground patches as flat one-colour discs, side cliffs with a moss bar every 32 px or a thin dark line, and a Thunder ground fill with rows of cyan dots. Everything else for these islands passed (ground shapes, cliffs, flowers, Lotus fill and water). Azure Beast Ravine has the same three problems on its 2nd try. The accepted islands (Center, Grove, Mine, Farm…) already have good patches, side cliffs and fills that could be recoloured to each new island's palette.

imgs.cap: Thunder Crag round 3 preview: flat disc patches, dark-line side cliffs, dotted fill

o: inhouse_recolour

We make them in-house: recolour the accepted patches, side cliffs and fills from the closest existing island to each new island's palette (Lotus from Grove, Thunder from Mine, Ravine from Farm/Grove), then judge them with the same checks
chatgpt_new_brief
One more ChatGPT round with a new brief that starts from an accepted island's file instead of its template
mix
Recolour in-house for the side cliffs and fills; ChatGPT redraws only the ground patches
later
Leave them until those islands are being built (Phase 6)
all
In-house now for all three new islands, AND for Tribulation Peak's patches/side cliffs/fill from the start

q: Fish and algae appear on the snow around the Fishing pond. How should that work?
ctx: The fish and algae spawn anywhere in the Fishing island's central zone (43×43 cells), but the drawn pond is only 14×10 cells, so most fish and algae sit on snow. The Algae Farm's 'water only' rule also treats that whole zone as water. Fixing it changes where you fish and how many fish/algae there are at once (spawn targets would be rebalanced so the pace stays the same).
o: pond_zone
Fish and algae only in the drawn pond (and the Algae Farm only on the pond); rebalance spawn counts so the pace stays the same
big_lake
Make the frozen lake much bigger so it covers the whole central zone (fewer buildable cells on Fishing)
ice_holes
Keep them spread out, but on snow they appear as ice-fishing holes (new small art piece) — fits the snowy island
pond_plus_holes
Fish in the pond AND at ice-fishing holes on the snow nearby; algae only in the pond
leave
Leave it as it is for now
